answer: Make standing decay 3 percent every epoch an identity does not answer, and cap graded answers per identity so volume cannot outrun the decay. Re-check a random sample of every batch against a second reviewer and compare the two verdicts. A farm pays to keep a thousand identities warm through every epoch and still earns at most the cap per identity. The beacon is the sampled re-check, the signal is a verdict that disagrees, and the falcon is the reviewer who catches it.
